notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market KM SaaS (B2B) building embeddable semantic search for support knowledge base and case routing.
- Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first for POC, then Dedicated for predictable throughput + cost.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-03: Intro demo (Maya) — showed Hosted embeddings flow and vector DB connectors.
- 2026-02-17: Technical deep-dive with Diego — discussed ingestion window, batching, KV cache behavior.
- 2026-03-02: Fireflies call with engineering + product (ff_20260302_8472) — agreed on 2-week ingestion POC.
- 2026-03-05: Sent security questionnaire (drive:/security/hopsail/security-questionnaire-2026.xlsx).
- 2026-03-10: Internal sizing meeting; finance requested pricing worksheet; Maya prepared initial ARR estimate.

Requirements and priorities (shorthand):
- Workloads: nightly batch embeddings (ETL), near-real-time query-time embeddings for re-ranking, semantic search serving at ~p95 latency target 60-80ms (search path).
- Ingestion: target ~1.5M docs/month => ~3.2M embeddings/month; nightly batch window 06:00-09:00 PST.
- Throughput target: batch embedding throughput target >2k embeddings/sec to finish within window; query QPS for top customers ~50-200 sustained.
- Vector DB: currently PoC with Weaviate; evaluating Pinecone and managed Postgres+pgvector. Need straightforward connector and snapshot/restore to S3.
- Model preferences: open embedding models first (cost), fallback to Redwood-curated models for quality; want quantized/low-cost options for Dedicated.
- Routing/fallback: ability to route reads to cheaper region/variant under load; automatic fallback to smaller model when Dedicated capacity constrained.

Security & compliance notes:
- SOC2 required; SSO/SAML mandatory for admin users.
- Need audit logging & KMS integration in Dedicated/private options.
- Legal asks about data residency for EU customers (may require VPC or Private deployment later).

POC plan / success criteria:
- 2-week Hosted API ingestion POC: ingest representative 100k doc sample, measure end-to-end embedding throughput, CPU/GPU utilization, and vector DB write throughput.
- Query P95 under 80ms for top-10 similarity queries with 10k candidates.
- Cost projection: estimate per-embedding unit cost and monthly bill for both Hosted and Dedicated scenarios.

Quotes / direct notes:
- "If we can get ingestion done in the nightly window and keep query latency stable, we can move to Dedicated for cost predictability." — Head of Product (call 2026-03-02).
- Engineering: "We need connectors that don't require custom glue every time — maintenance burden is a blocker."

- Schedule Dedicated sizing demo with infra team (Diego) — proposed 2026-03-18.
- Finance to review pricing worksheet; follow-up thread: thread_20260213_8849.

- Legal asks about EU residency could push Private discussion earlier.
